name: Ysera's Blessing shortens Gaze of Ysera and lowers its break chance (#702)
contract: #702: Ysera's Blessing 704820 carries two ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107) effects with class mask {0, 0x40000000, 0}, the family flag of Gaze of Ysera 806148: MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) base -501 -> -500 ms, and MiscValue 18 (SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS) base -11 -> -10. Gaze of Ysera has cast-time index 16 = 1500 ms, so it becomes 1000 ms. Gaze's proc chance goes through Aura::CalcProcChance, which applies SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS, so the 100% break chance of its MOD_STUN proc (ProcFlags 0x222a8) becomes 90%. Only the modifier values are asserted: the report could not read spell_proc rows, so the observed break fraction on a dummy is not asserted. Destroyer's Maw 802107 is the control for the mask.

steps.label: Gaze of Ysera casts in 1500 ms before the talent
Gaze of Ysera has a 100 chance modifier base before the talent
Ysera's Blessing removes 500 ms from the Gaze of Ysera cast time
Ysera's Blessing lowers the Gaze of Ysera break chance from 100 to 90
The cast-time cut does not leak onto Destroyer's Maw
The chance cut does not leak onto Destroyer's Maw
